location_exception_reason: Bamboo huts are regionally sourced and location-dependent products; bamboo quality, treatment standards, and availability vary significantly by region (Northeast India, South India, Odisha). Buyer decisions are materially influenced by origin region and local bamboo sourcing credibility. Location in title serves as a genuine product quality and authenticity signal, not merely a seller identifier.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer, Exporter) are redundant in bamboo hut titles; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this information independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' or 'Supplier' from a title leaves the product description complete and unchanged. The product is a bamboo hut regardless of seller classification.
